data.title: 卡莲 · 壁炉圣经前的倚肩依偎
data.description: 【卡莲 · 壁炉圣经前的倚肩依偎】深夜火光微跳的教会休息室，柴火噼啪作响。卡莲身穿黑色真丝吊带睡裙坐在厚地毯上，双手合着一本厚重的皮革圣经，身体不知不觉倚靠在你肩头。微弱的火光勾勒出她优美修长的颈项与露背曲线，银白发丝垂在你胸前，呼吸均匀而恬静——「只有在这一刻……我才能忘记世间那些嘈杂的声音，感受到真正的安息。」
data.location: 教会后室石砌壁炉前的厚织羊毛地毯上
data.action: 合着圣经将头轻倚在视角肩头，火光映照侧颜，嘴角挂着静谧的安心微笑
data.lighting: 石砌壁炉柴火跳跃的暖红光影
data.camera: cowboy shot, eye level, Bible, shoulder contact and stone hearth visible
data.promptProse: A closed leather-bound Bible rests across Caren Hortensia's lap on the thick hearth rug. Both hands support its cover as she leans her head against the clothed shoulder at the frame edge, her black silk nightgown and thin straps remaining in place. Her amber-yellow eyes follow the embers with a calm smile. The eye-level cowboy view places the stone hearth beside her; the rug edge leads toward a low reading chair and the shaded wall beyond. Firelight catches the book's worn spine, silver hair and nearer shoulder. The hearth stones return softer warmth to the shaded sleeve-free arm, while the book casts a gentle shadow across her lap and the chair legs disappear into the quieter room.
